title: WhatsApp — "Remote Data Entry" task job
text: Hi! I'm Sarah from TalentBridge HR 👋 We saw your resume online and you're PRE-APPROVED for our Remote Data Entry Assistant position. Pay is $45/hour, only 2-3 hours a day, work from home. No interview needed, you can start today! To set up your account we just need a $35 registration fee (Zelle or Bitcoin is fastest). We'll also send you a starter kit — just cover the $60 shipping cost. Please message me on WhatsApp ASAP so we don't give the spot to someone else, only a few slots left!

title: Email — "Remote Data Analyst" job offer (subtle scam)
text:
Hi Aryan,

Thank you for completing the written interview with our hiring team over Teams chat yesterday. We're pleased to offer you the Remote Data Analyst (Entry Level) position at Meridian Health Partners: $34/hour, 30 hours per week, fully remote.

To begin onboarding, please reply with a photo of your driver's license and complete the direct deposit form attached. Since you'll be working from home, our finance department will mail you a check for your home-office setup. Once it clears, you'll purchase your laptop and software from our approved equipment vendor, whose details we'll share after you deposit it.

Please confirm your acceptance by Friday so we can hold your start date.

Best regards,
Daniel Brooks
Talent Acquisition, Meridian Health Partners
d.brooks@meridianhealth-careers.com

title: Email — Software Engineer interview request
text:
Hi Aryan,

Thanks for applying to the Software Engineer, Backend role at Northline Analytics. I reviewed your resume and would love to set up a 30-minute phone screen with our engineering manager next week.

Could you share a couple of times that work on Tuesday or Wednesday? We're in the Mountain time zone. If it's easier, feel free to grab a slot directly on our scheduling page: careers.northlineanalytics.com/schedule.

As a reminder, our interview process is: phone screen, a take-home exercise, then a final panel interview. There's no cost to you at any step, and all offers come with a written offer letter from our HR team.

Looking forward to chatting,
Priya Raman
Talent Acquisition, Northline Analytics
priya.raman@northlineanalytics.com
